input.query: WITH monthly AS (SELECT a.month, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active) AS active_users, SUM(a.card_spend_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active),0) AS spend_per_active_user, SUM(a.n_card_txns) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active),0) AS txns_per_active_user FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' GROUP BY a.month) SELECT * FROM monthly WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2026-05-01' ORDER BY month
